description: [FIND · door] Look up a VALUE deterministically from the engine's offline, public-domain data — the found-value twin of `verify` (look it up, then verify it), consolidated like verify into one tool. kind is one of: molar_mass {formula}, element {symbol|name|atomic_number}, convert {value, from, to}. Returns the value + its source; found=false (never a guess) when unknown. Call with an unknown kind to list the current kinds. The agent twin of GET /lookup.
name: lookup
